notes.title: Memory Lane Update!
notes.content:
The Memory Lane demo version has been revised. 

In addition to small changes like increasing the running speed, there are also story changes that improve the game experience for everyone! 

Furthermore, the ending sequence and credits have been altered. I would be happy if you revisit the demo and tell me how you liked it!

notes.title: Memory Lane Showcase
notes.content:
Memory Lane joins the Steam Next Fest via a live stream!

Tune in on Wednesday at 7:00 pm CEST to learn more about the game and get a closer look behind the scenes!

We will play a bit of the game and I'll answer questions about future plans regarding Memory Lane. Spread the word and stay awesome, everybody!

notes.title: Memory Lane is now live on Kickstarter!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40878170/58164dcabe0a42d1ed274b0ab0347839b7e2c3a5.png[/img]

Memory Lane is now live on Kickstarter!

Klick [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/1875015578/memory-lane-2]here[/url] to learn more about it!

Getting the game funded would mean that I can work on this game full time while not having to worry about everyday stuff like bills, rent and food. With almost every stretch goal we hit, I'm reducing the price  of the game as well. 

Should we manage to reach the last stretch goal, I'll release the game for free! This is my very unconventional way of thanking you. I don't really believe in putting more and more content in a story driven game that is narritiveley finished in my head. It just wouldn't feel natural.

Please consider supporting me on Kickstarter! If you don't want or can't support me financially, spread the word! Let people know that the game exists! It would help me out a ton!

Thank you so very much for your support!

Sincerely,
Dennis
